rationale: Third-party bodily injury (neighbor's child) arising from a condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), directly covered under homeowner's liability.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Medical bills are anticipated, and immediate adjuster follow-up is needed to manage this pediatric injury claim and ensure proper documentation of the incident and medical treatment.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.claim_basis: slip and fall on icy walkway; medical bills anticipated
